artworks.title: Fountain with Statue of Neptune
artworks.description: The image shows a fountain sculpture with a central figure of a male deity holding a trident. The deity is seated on a woven structure with three putti pouring water into a basin below. The basin is decorated with reliefs of human figures, animals, and acanthus leaves. Two putti above dolphins are below the basin. The sculpture rests on a base with wave patterns.

artworks.title: Louis XV
artworks.artist: Jakob Christoffel Le Blon after Nicholas Blakey
artworks.medium: color mezzotint and etching printed in black, yellow, blue, carmine, brown, and white inks
artworks.description: The image shows a man with curly white hair wearing a blue coat with a star-shaped emblem. He is positioned facing slightly to the left, with his head turned towards the viewer. He has strong eyebrows, a prominent nose, and a subtle lipline. Underneath his coat, he wears a white ruffled shirt. The background is dark and indistinct.

artworks.title: Brunnhilde
artworks.description: The image displays a profile view of a person from the head to just below the shoulders, seated or resting. The individual has long, wavy hair flowing past their shoulders. Their facial features are softly outlined, with a composed expression, looking forward. They wear a simple garment, and the background includes faint vertical lines and light shading, with two small flowers sketched.

artworks.title: Parsifal
artworks.description: This is a close-up, monochromatic drawing of a person shown from the chest upwards. The person is in a static position, facing forward. The facial features are softly defined with dark eyes, a straight nose, and unsmiling lips. Their hair is covered by a textured helmet or cap that covers the head entirely, fitting closely and extending down towards the neck. The person is wearing a cloak with evident folds and a high, possibly ribbed collar visible beneath. Their right hand is holding a long spear and is at the edge of the image. The background is dark and textured.

artworks.title: Perversite (Perversity)
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the shoulders up, with their head turned slightly to the side. The person's face is positioned in profile, with distinct facial features including a refined nose and subtle chin. The person has short, textured hair styled close to the scalp. They appear to be wearing draped fabric, with the surrounding background mainly dark to create a contrast. The composition emphasizes light and shadow, giving it a dramatic and classical appearance.

artworks.title: Head of Cabbage with Insects
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 18.6 x 28.5 cm (7 5/16 x 11 1/4 in.)
support: 19.4 x 29.2 cm (7 5/8 x 11 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a large head of a cabbage at its center, with butterflies and various insects surrounding it. The cabbage is shades of green with variations in color creating depth and texture to the leaves. The butterflies have vibrant colors including orange, black, and white, contrasting with the cabbage. Various insects are placed around the cabbage: a butterfly on the left, another near the center, a ladybug near the top right, and other insects towards the right and lower parts. The background is a neutral beige color.

artworks.title: Four Scenes from the Legends of Judas and Pilate
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash,  heightened with white and gold, on gray prepared paper (grisaille)
artworks.dimensions: overall (rounded top edge): 15.9 x 18.2 cm (6 1/4 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of four medieval scenes. The image portrays four distinct panels illustrating different narratives set against a stylized medieval architectural background. The upper left panel depicts two women kneeling in front of an altar while a third woman stands behind them. The upper right panel shows a violent scene with one figure standing over another ready to strike with a weapon. The lower left panel features a dramatic moment of distress with one figure standing near another figure lying on the ground. The lower right panel illustrates a bedroom scene with one figure standing at the bedside confronting a person in bed, with a dog on the floor. This artwork is in the style of a medieval or early Renaissance artist, showcasing detailed social interactions within a historical context.

artworks.title: Four Scenes from the Life of Christ
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash,  heightened with white and gold, on gray prepared paper (grisaille)
artworks.dimensions: overall (rounded top edge): 15.9 x 18.3 cm (6 1/4 x 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a series of religious scenes divided into four quadrants. In the upper left quadrant, a figure is mounted on a donkey surrounded by a crowd. The upper right quadrant shows an interior with figures gathered around engaged in an act of teaching or discussion, highlighted by architectural elements. The lower left quadrant portrays figures in a formal posture, possibly in a procession or ceremonial context. The lower right quadrant reveals an interior setting where a group is interacting around a central figure. The scenes are detailed with an emphasis on architectural and figural elements, in shades of grey with gold highlights. The style is reminiscent of religious iconography from early Renaissance or late Gothic periods.

artworks.title: Mercury
artworks.description: This drawing depicts an architectural and urban scene showing craftsmen at work. The scene includes various craftsmen engaging in their trades, an architectural archway, a figure seated at a desk with tools, workbenches, buildings with different arches and windows, and celestial imagery with an emblematic figure among the clouds.

artworks.title: The Madonna Spinning
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated with a child standing beside her and another child wrapped in cloth lying on a surface. The woman is holding a distaff in her right hand and gesturing with her left hand towards the child. She has classical facial features and styled hair, and is wearing a flowing dress. The setting is indoors with draped curtains, a window showing the sky, and a basket of circular objects on the floor. The image features a dense cross-hatching style.

artworks.title: Johann Gottfried von Herder
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait drawing of a man from the waist up. He is facing slightly to the right and looking directly at the viewer with a slight smile. His facial features include a straight nose, round cheeks, and a friendly expression. He has styled back hair tied in a traditional 18th-century manner, possibly in a queue or ponytail. The man is wearing a formal outfit typical of the period, comprising a high-collared shirt with a cravat, a waistcoat with buttons, and a coat with detailed cuffs and lapels. He is enclosed within an oval ornamental frame decorated with drapery and cord designs. The background, visible within the oval frame, has a textured shading for depth.

artworks.title: Frau Gottfried von Herder
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman in an ornate oval frame. She is facing slightly to the left with a gentle smile, detailed facial features, styled hair with a lace cap, and an elegant dress with ruffles. She wears jewelry and is surrounded by floral decorations and bows in the frame.

artworks.title: The Brook in the Woods
artworks.description: The image shows a forest landscape with a narrow creek in the foreground. The canopy blocks the view of the horizon, and the intricate brushstrokes capture the details of the trees and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with sepia tones. Rocks and vegetation are close to the viewer, and branches and leaves fill the background.

artworks.title: Landscape with Shepherds Driving Away a Wolf
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with touches of pale green wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon line, featuring distant hills on the left side with a castle and a church with a spire on the right side. Pen-and-ink strokes are intricately detailed, depicting trees and the flowing lines of the landscape. The color scheme is monochromatic with shades of brown and sepia. A group of figures, potentially hunters with dogs, are depicted in motion on the foreground terrain. Beyond them are trees, hills, and architectural structures on higher ground.

artworks.title: St. Georg (Saint George)
artworks.description: The etched artwork depicts the upper body of a person in motion from the knees up. The person is positioned with one foot forward, holding a large shovel or similar tool with both hands. Their face is turned slightly towards the viewer, with large, expressive eyes, a defined nose, and a closed mouth. The person has short, wavy hair. They are wearing a simple long-sleeved garment with sleeves rolled up to the elbows. The background is abstract with diagonal lines and curved shapes.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Saint Anthony
artworks.description: The image is a medieval-style engraving with a comprehensive scene showing figures near us and a vast landscape in the distance. The horizon is marked by hills, a cloudy sky with flying creatures and demons. Close to us, people and mythical creatures interact near the ruins of a large ancient structure. In the middle and further, smaller figures are spread across a rugged landscape with trees and rocky outcrops up to the distant horizon. The artwork uses black and white with detailed linework, typical of woodcut engravings, creating a high-contrast scene. The details of clothing, architecture, and foliage contribute to a rich tapestry of scenes filled with movement and interaction.

artworks.title: The Reformers Luther and Hus Giving Communion to the Princes of the House of Saxony
Venus and Cupid
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing next to a small winged figure holding a bow. The woman has a serene expression with styled hair, and is draped in a cloth. She wears jewelry on her neck and head. To her right is a tree trunk with a shield featuring designs and inscriptions. The background includes a medieval town nestled in hilly terrain under a sky filled with clouds.

artworks.title: Un Monsieur au dessous de ses affaires
artworks.description: The image shows a man walking against the wind or cold. His arms are bent behind his back, holding his coat closed. The man wears a tall top hat and has a furrowed brow and a slightly downturned mouth. He has shoulder-length hair visible beneath his hat. The man wears a dark coat and lighter-colored trousers, with the coat flapping behind him as he walks. Above him is a sign that reads "MORT DE LA PIETE." The scene is shaded to indicate snowfall or rain, with white specks contrasting against the darker tones. The background features a city street with other buildings visible, all in gray tones.

artworks.title: Le Jour ou il faut se montrer galant
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman standing in front of a flower stall. The woman is wearing a bonnet, a long-sleeved garment, and has her hair tucked underneath. The man is wearing a top hat, a formal coat, and a high-collared shirt, holding a bouquet of flowers and gesturing with a stick. They are surrounded by various flowers on the stall. The background is shaded with no distinct objects or landscape visible.

artworks.title: Le Nouveau tapissier de la couronne...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person cutting fabric in a room. The image depicts a figure cutting a large piece of patterned fabric with a pair of scissors, positioned in front of a chair. The person is dressed in a long garment and wears a vest, deeply focused on their task. The drawing shows texture in the fabric and conveys the solidity of the chair. The background includes subtle embellishments and a sense of an opulent interior setting with wood paneling or wallpaper featuring faint designs.

artworks.title: Expliquez-moi donc, monsieur Badoulard...
artworks.description: The image displays three men captured from the waist up. The first man is on the left, facing the second man directly and pointing towards him. He has a mustache and sideburns, and his hair is mostly hidden by a military-style cap. He wears a dark uniform with large, light-colored epaulettes and a sash across his chest. The second man stands in the center, wearing spectacles and a similar uniform to the first man, including a draped sash. The third man is on the right, slightly angled towards the first man, with his hands clasped in front of him. He also has a mustache, wears a tall ornate hat with a plume, and a dark military uniform with epaulettes and a cross-body sash. The background seems to be an interior setting with a wooden floor and a cylindrical structure, possibly a stove pipe, in one corner.
